Name: Santa Slay
Overview:
You and a friend (optional) play as Santa Clause and Stumpy in rocket powered sleighs on a quest for revenge. Fly everywhere from the deserts of Afghanistan to the snowy mountains of Siberia, using ten different power-ups to wreck havoc on armies of terrorists, mutant plants, space aliens and much more.

Despite its simple appearance, this game is quite complex and challenging. You'll die... a lot.
